reasoning_traces.think:
The system models provider readiness as a binary vector space where each dimension corresponds to an API key's presence. The fallback mechanism operates as a stochastic projection onto a Lagrangian subspace defined by the hermes fallback list. When primary provider fails, the system transitions to a deterministic fallback state governed by conditional probabilities derived from past performance. HTTP errors act as compatibility tensors that define a failure manifold in the provider-model space. These structures enable GSI to perform Bayesian model selection and GSE to execute adaptive state transitions based on empirical telemetry.
